- **api** — src/**/api/**/*.ts, src/routes/**/*.ts — [API-01, APIP-01]
- **auth** — src/**/auth/** — [—]
- **db** — (always) — [DBP-01, DBG-01..04, DB-01]
- **frontend** — src/**/*.tsx, src/components/**/*.tsx — [FRON-01, FRONP-01]
- **infra** — (always) — [—]
- **services** — (always) — [SERV-01..03, SERVP-01..05, SERVG-01..02]
